name: Kusaka Hozumi
source: Sachikazu's upperclassman and the daughter of a priest who also works as a miko. She is rather naive due to her mother teaching her. Despite her cool outlook, in her heart, Hozumi is just a girl who can't be honest with herself. Taking Manjuu-sama's words to her heart, she starts fulfilling her duty by working at "Misoka An".
